title: Contractor Rate Card for Self-Help Cures, Community Rules & Site Care
content:
The self-help charge on a Community Rules & Site Care plan record is built from the community's contract visit rates.

**The notice and the work date.** The notice charged is the violation notice most recently served on the plan record, and the work date is the date of the most recent cure outcome recorded as cured by the community.

**Contract visit rates.** The contractor invoices self-help work at the community's contract visit rates, one visit per cure:

| Rule class of the notice | Contract visit rate |
|---|---|
| Lawn and landscaping | $50.00 |
| Debris and storage | $120.00 |
| Snow and ice | $65.00 |

The contractor's cost is that visit rate, stated rounded half up to the cent.

**The charge.** The self-help charge is the contractor's cost plus the plan's self-help administration fee, rounded half up to the cent.

## Worked example

A hypothetical administration fee of $40.00, chosen for illustration and not a schedule value:

| Cure | Contractor's cost | Self-help charge |
|---|---|---|
| Debris and storage | $120.00 | $120.00 plus $40.00, which is $160.00 |
| Lawn and landscaping | $50.00 | $90.00 |
| Snow and ice | $65.00 | $105.00 |

## Which notice is charged

A hypothetical record carries a lawn notice served 2 June and a debris notice served 9 June. The notice charged is the debris notice of 9 June, the most recently served, and its visit rate is $120.00.
